title: red-pipeline and the revert check read the newest main pipeline where a job ran
goal: ql_deliver.job_ran and RAN_AND_FAILED (script_failure, job_execution_timeout, stuck_or_timeout_failure) decide which jobs ran and which failed; backlog.py red-pipeline reads the newest finished pipeline of main in which a job ran (the newest finished one only when none did), and --job NAME reads the newest one in which that job ran; a filed bug's repro is red-pipeline --status --job <its first failed job>, so it fails until that job passes again, not until any later push; ql_deliver.ci_pipeline reads the newest pipeline of the commit where a job ran; kb/_self/backlog.md and querylog.md say so; tests plant a red started pipeline followed by newer unstarted ones and a timed-out job
